apps/web/components/features/dashboard/o.offline: The section has no distinct offline UI: a failed billing fetch renders the same Billing unavailable panel shown in the ErrorUnavailable story.
apps/web/components/features/dashboard/o.permission-denied: Billing has no permission gate; every signed-in owner sees their own billing. The detector matched the words plan and upgrade, and a free account sees Compare plans in the base stories.

apps/web/components/features/dashboard/o.offline: A failed contacts load while offline renders the same retry panel shown in the ErrorLoadFailed story; there is no separate offline UI.
A save that fails offline goes through the same failure path as the ErrorSaveFailed story; the section has no separate offline UI.
apps/web/components/features/dashboard/o.long-content: The section title, descriptions and toggle labels are fixed copy in the component; no caller text reaches it, so it cannot grow long.

apps/web/components/features/dashboard/o.offline: A failed pay summary fetch while offline renders the same panel as the ErrorSummaryFailed story; there is no separate offline UI.
A save that fails offline goes through the same failure path as the ErrorSaveFailed story; the section has no separate offline UI.
apps/web/components/features/dashboard/o.long-content: The title, description and toggle label are fixed copy in the component; no caller text reaches it, so it cannot grow long.

apps/web/components/features/dashboard/o.offline: The section makes no network call of its own; an unreachable session reads as signed out, which the base SignedOut story covers.
The sidebar makes no network call; it hands edits to onSave, and an offline save failure reaches it only as contact.error, which the ErrorSaveFailed story covers.
apps/web/components/features/dashboard/o.permission-denied: The sidebar has no permission gate. The detector matched role, which here is the contact type select (ContactRole), not an access role.

apps/web/components/features/dashboard/o.offline: The table is fed by props and makes no network call; isLoading comes from the parent, and offline save errors belong to useContactsManager, not this table.
apps/web/components/features/dashboard/o.permission-denied: The table has no permission gate. The detector matched role, which here is the contact role column (ContactRole), not an access role.

apps/web/components/features/dashboard/o.long-content: Every label comes from the fixed SEGMENT_OPTIONS list in the component; no caller text reaches the menu, so it cannot grow long.
The meter draws five fixed-height bars and the fixed label 'Engagement N of 5' from a 0-100 score; there is no caller text to lengthen. The detector matched aria-label.
apps/web/components/features/dashboard/o.permission-denied: The meter has no permission input or gated action; the detector matched role='img' on the bar group.

apps/web/components/features/dashboard/o.long-content: AudienceLastCell renders only a compact relative time (now, 5m, 3h, 12d) or an em dash computed from lastSeenAt; there is no caller text to lengthen. The detector matched the text-2xs class.
The badge text is one of the four fixed AUDIENCE_STATE_LABELS (High, Rising, Dormant, Subscriber); no caller text reaches it, so it cannot grow long.

apps/web/components/features/dashboard/o.empty: NowMsContext is a timestamp provider with no UI of its own; it renders its children unchanged and owns no collection that could be empty.
apps/web/components/features/dashboard/o.long-content: NowMsContext renders no text; it only supplies a number to consumers through context, so there is nothing to lengthen.
apps/web/components/features/dashboard/o.rtl-overflow: NowMsContext renders no markup beyond its children, so document direction cannot change its output. The detector matched the children prop.

apps/web/components/features/dashboard/o.offline: The feed has no offline UI of its own: react-query pauses the fetch while offline and keeps the last loaded list, and a fetch that fails lands on the ErrorLoadFailed story. A distinct offline treatment would be a design call.
